However, the Jensen Huang-led firm could narrow the gap if it increases its cash return to shareholders, investment firm Melius Research said.

“While the gap peaked at a ~60% discount in June, it could narrow further as investors start to place a greater value on semis companies that can return cash to shareholders,” Melius analyst Ben Reitzes wrote in a note to clients. “Companies like Nvidia, Sandisk and soon Micron are picking up the pace of buybacks, which could really stand out in the face of rate fears and within a market that will need to absorb further issuances.”
